newsitem.title: USA: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Cornerstone Prop. gains.
newsitem.headline: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Cornerstone Prop. gains.

text.p: Real estate investment trust Cornerstone Properties Inc recorded modest gains on its first day of trading on the Big Board, after pricing below its filing range of $15 to $17 a share.
The shares, priced at $14 each, climbed 3/8 to 14-3/8 with over two million shares trading hands by the afternoon. Merrill Lynch was lead underwriter on the $14 million share offering.

Shares of ASI Solutions Inc were flat at $6 after opening with a 1/2 point premium. The size of the deal had been reduced to 1.8 million shares at an estimated price of $6 to $6.50 each from 2.2 million shares at $7 to $8 each.
H.C. Wainwright was lead underwriter on the human resource services provider's offering.
DeCrane Aircraft Holdings Inc also made its debut on the back of a price cut, and its shares were flat at $12. The range had been earlier reduced from $13 to $15 to $12 to $13.50 a share.
The company offered about 2.8 million shares, and the deal was lead managed by Schroder, Wertheim & Co.
Wheels Sports Group Inc also priced and was due to trade on Wednesday, but hadn't done so by 1520 EDT/1920 GMT. The 900,000 shares were priced at $5.90 each by Schneider Securities.
